en: A black and white postcard showing a panoramic view of a large castle-like structure with prominent towers and a cathedral on a hill, overlooking a river. In the foreground, a large steamship or paddle steamer is visible on the river. At the bottom of the image, some small figures are bathing or standing on the riverbank. The text on the card identifies the location as Meißen an der Elbe, referring to the Albrechtsburg castle and the cathedral (Dom).
